hints: The Lions squad has $n = 11$ players. Find the rank of the median: $\frac{11 + 1}{2} = 6$th value.
Find the lower quartile $Q_1$ (3rd value) and upper quartile $Q_3$ (9th value).
Calculate the interquartile range $\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1$.
walkthrough:
Step 1: List the ordered Lions data.
$$169, 178, 179, 180, 181, 186, 187, 189, 190, 190, 196$$
Total count $n = 11$.

Step 2: Find the median.
$$\text{Position of median} = \frac{n + 1}{2} = \frac{12}{2} = 6$$
The 6th value in the ordered list is $186$ cm.
$$\text{Median} = 186\text{ cm}$$

Step 3: Find the quartiles.
The lower half of data contains the 5 values below the median:
$$169, 178, 179, 180, 181$$
The median of these 5 values is the 3rd value:
$$Q_1 = 179\text{ cm}$$
The upper half of data contains the 5 values above the median:
$$187, 189, 190, 190, 196$$
The median of these 5 values is the 9th overall value:
$$Q_3 = 190\text{ cm}$$

Step 4: Compute the IQR.
$$\text{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 190 - 179 = 11\text{ cm}$$
